missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Грязь' is a feminine soft-sign noun and stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Ужасная' and 'весенняя' are agreeing feminine adjectives.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Грязь' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'развели', identical to the nominative form. 'На полу' is a prepositional location phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Грязи' is the genitive form after 'много' to express amount. 'После дождя' is a genitive time phrase, and 'кругом' is an adverb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Грязи' is the prepositional form after 'в' to express location. 'Густой' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'машина' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after без. 'Грязи' is the genitive form required by 'без' to express absence. 'Весной' is an instrumental time adverb meaning in spring.
Strategic focus: Genitive after слой. 'Грязи' is the genitive form depending on 'слоем' to mean a layer of. 'Дорога' is the subject and 'покрыта' a short adjective.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Грязью' is the instrumental form expressing what the boots were smeared with. 'Сапоги' is the nominative plural subject and 'измазаны' a short adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative after по. 'Грязи' is the dative form after 'по' to express movement over a surface. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject of 'идут'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Грязь' is the feminine accusative object of 'смыли', identical to the nominative. 'Всю' agrees in the accusative, and 'водой' is instrumental of means.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Грязях' is the prepositional plural form after 'в', a marked plural used for mud over wide areas. 'Улицы' is the nominative plural subject of 'тонут'.
